reporting-org.narrative: Norad - Norwegian Agency for Development Cooperation

description.narrative:
The project intends to contribute to safeguarding the livelihoods of the most affected, most at risk vulnerable households in Middle Shabelle and Jubaland States of Somalia. It seeks to help mitigate the impact of the drought and help affected communities in rebuilding their lives while also cushioning them against recurrent shocks. The proposed project will contribute to the overall achievement of FAO’s Country Partnership Framework (CPF). Norway’s intended financial contribution will be softly earmarked to outcomes 2 and outcome 3 of the CPF detailed below.
Outcomes: o Outcome one: Natural resources are sustainably managed and binding constraints addressed in key productive sector value chains, leading to productivity gains, increased value addition and enhanced opportunities for decent work. o Outcome two: The number of people impacted by climate change, natural disasters, and environmental degradation is reduced.
